issue.title: After bob types ships: spell chezmoi's vocabulary types: and preview bob types migrate on the live vault

task_type_fields.proposal:
After the daily release train ships a bob that has `bob types` (the installed bob 0.4.0 still rejects `bob types` and reads only `themes:`), finish the two post-release steps from the bob-cli-e6 task-types closeout (plan:202610/task_types.md, phase `closeout`), proposed by bob-cli-e6.16 note #1:

1. **chezmoi vocabulary spelling.** Confirm the installed bob reads `types:`: run `bob types list -f json` against a temp config whose vocabulary block is spelled `types:` and check that `configured_themes` is populated. If it is, open the chezmoi repo with `/sase_repo`, rename `themes:` to `types:` in `home/dot_config/bob/config.yml` (keep the entries and comments), and commit `bob: spell the type vocabulary types:`. Never run `chezmoi apply`; Bryan applies it.
2. **Live-vault migrate preview.** Run `bob types migrate -d` against Bryan's live vault (dry-run, read-only) and report the per-file field/default counts, `needs_repair`, and `conflicts` to Bryan in a bead note. Bryan runs the write himself (`bob types migrate`, undo with `git revert` plus `bob vault-sync`).

Done when the chezmoi commit exists (or a note explains why `types:` still is not read) and the dry-run preview is recorded.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Both steps need an installed bob that already has `bob types` and reads `types:`. bob-cli ships only through the daily release train (decisions:bob-cli-releases-ride-a-daily-train), so the bob-cli-e6 epic cannot finish them before it closes. Switching chezmoi earlier would make the installed 0.4.0 drop the vocabulary block.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-e6.16 could not switch chezmoi's themes: block to types: or preview bob types migrate, because the installed bob 0.4.0 has no bob types yet. Both steps must wait for the next release.

payload.description: Deferred closeout steps of the task-types epic (phase closeout, bob-cli-e6.16 note #1)
